entries.name: G0C.MAXV
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

entries.name: L1D.WHERE
entries.body: 'WT' BIND 0 WT LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'WI' BIND WT WI GET ] FILTER
entries.note: non-empty Vector of truths -> Vector of the indices holding TRUE

entries.name: L1C.RSTEP
entries.body: 'V' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'P' BIND A 1 GET 'I' BIND I 0 1 P V EQ SELECT ADD 'NI' BIND V NI 2 COLLECT
entries.note: Run-id step (previous, id) with element: id goes up by 1 when the element differs from the previous one.

entries.name: L1C.RUNIDS
entries.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ L1C.RSTEP ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
entries.note: Vector to the run id of each element; equal adjacent values share an id, ids ascend from 0.

entries.name: L1A.ARGMAX
entries.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

entries.name: L1A.TOPKEY
entries.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES L1A.ARGMAX GET
entries.note: key of a Record whose (numeric) value is largest, first key on ties

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: L1C.CODE1
entries.body: 'C' BIND '([)]' C SEARCH 'P' BIND [ 1 2 -1 -2 ] P GET
entries.note: One bracket character to its code: open paren 1, close paren -1, open square 2, close square -2.
